usage: Used for a local physical office of a bank, not the whole bank as an institution.
Very common with verbs like 去、入、搵、開戶口、存款、提款, especially in daily errands.
Neutral and practical in Hong Kong speech and writing; it sounds natural in formal or everyday contexts.
For small learner-friendly context, think of the specific office you go to when you need face-to-face banking service.
